title: Removing the fine print: Disclosure, standardized products, and consumer outcomes
title_zh: 去除细则：信息披露、标准化产品与消费者结果
title_primary: 去除细则：信息披露、标准化产品与消费者结果
title_secondary: Removing the fine print: Disclosure, standardized products, and consumer outcomes
authors: Sheisha Kulkarni, Santiago Truffa, Gonzalo Iberti
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Hidden fees can distort consumer decision-making. In response, regulators historically have (a) improved disclosure to make fees more salient or (b) standardized products to restrict what fees can be charged. We use Chilean administrative data and a multi-stage natural experiment to separately identify the effects of disclosure and standardization on repayment. We find that disclosure reduces delinquencies by 13.7 percentage points (40%) and default by 1.68 percentage points (98%), whereas standardization has no effect. We find no effect on initial loan terms, suggesting that disclosure’s effects are specific to repayment behavior: specifically, disclosure improves borrowers’ understanding of their credit obligations.
abstract_zh: 隐藏费用可能扭曲消费者的决策。为此，监管机构历来采取两种措施：（a）改进信息披露，使费用更加显眼；或（b）标准化产品，限制可收取的费用类型。我们利用智利的行政数据及一个多阶段自然实验，分别识别信息披露与标准化对还款行为的影响。研究发现，信息披露能将逾期率降低13.7个百分点（降幅40%），并将违约率降低1.68个百分点（降幅98%），而标准化则无显著效果。我们未发现对初始贷款条款的影响，这表明信息披露的效果特定于还款行为：具体而言，信息披露增强了借款人对自身信贷义务的理解。

title: Spillover effects and volatility persistence in agricultural commodities: an empirical study of Lumber, Grain and Soft markets
title_zh: 农产品溢出效应与波动持续性：木材、谷物及软性商品市场的实证研究
title_primary: 农产品溢出效应与波动持续性：木材、谷物及软性商品市场的实证研究
title_secondary: Spillover effects and volatility persistence in agricultural commodities: an empirical study of Lumber, Grain and Soft markets
authors: Umar Kayani, Farrukh Nawaz, Maaz Khan, David Roubaud
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the dynamics of return spillovers in the Lumber, Grain and Soft commodity markets, by adopting the DY 2012 Spillover Framework on the daily frequency data from January 2010 to December 2023. The findings confirm the interconnectedness and spillover effects among various agricultural commodities, quantified by a spillover index value of 20.90%, indicating a notable degree of market interconnectedness. The net spillover analysis shows that Corn Futures emerge as major return spillover transmitters, however, while Oats and Coffee Futures are identified as the primary recipients. Furthermore, the GJR-GARCH model result revealed that Lumber Futures exhibit the highest level of volatility persistence, followed by Sugar Futures, highlighting the presence of asymmetric volatility behaviours. However, Oats and coffee show a negative leverage effect in the market. The DCC-GJR-GARCH model further reveals time-varying correlations among commodity pairs, with persistently high co-movement observed across the sample period. Our research findings contribute to the in-depth understanding of the complex dynamics of the agricultural commodity market and provide significant insights to financial investors and policymakers. abstract_zh: 本研究采用DY 2012溢出框架，基于2010年1月至2023年12月的日度频率数据，考察了木材、谷物及软性大宗商品市场的收益溢出动态。研究结果证实了各类农产品之间的相互关联性及溢出效应，通过溢出指数值20.90%予以量化，表明市场具有显著的互联程度。净溢出分析显示，玉米期货成为主要的收益溢出传递者，而燕麦和咖啡期货则被识别为主要接收者。此外，GJR-GARCH模型结果表明，木材期货表现出最高水平的波动持续性，其次为糖期货，凸显了非对称波动行为的存在。然而，燕麦和咖啡在市场呈现负杠杆效应。DCC-GJR-GARCH模型进一步揭示了商品对之间时变的相关性，在整个样本期内观察到持续较高的协同运动。本研究结果有助于深入理解农产品市场的复杂动态，并为金融投资者和政策制定者提供重要见解。关键词：商品市场 收益溢出 波动性 GJR-GARCH DCC-GJR-GARCH JEL分类：Q14 Q50

title: DP11005 Forward Guidance in the Yield Curve: Short Rates versus Bond Supply
title_zh: 收益率曲线中的前瞻性指引：短期利率与债券供给
title_primary: 收益率曲线中的前瞻性指引：短期利率与债券供给
title_secondary: DP11005 Forward Guidance in the Yield Curve: Short Rates versus Bond Supply
authors: Robin Greenwood, Samuel G Hanson, Dimitri Vayanos
official: 官方在线 2015-12-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We present a model of the yield curve in which the central bank can provide market participants with forward guidance on both future short rates and on future Quantitative Easing (QE) operations, which affect bond supply. Forward guidance on short rates works through the expectations hypothesis, while forward guidance on QE works through expected future bond risk premia. If a QE operation is expected to be undone in the near term, then its announcement will have a hump-shaped effect on the yield and forward-rate curves; otherwise the effect may be increasing with maturity. Humps associated to QE announcements typically occur at maturities longer than those associated to short-rate announcements, even when the effects of the former are expected to last over a shorter horizon. We use our model to re-examine the empirical evidence on QE announcements in the US.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个收益率曲线模型，其中中央银行可以向市场参与者提供关于未来短期利率及未来量化宽松（QE）操作的远期指引，这些操作影响债券供给。关于短期利率的远期指引通过预期假说发挥作用，而关于QE的远期指引则通过预期未来债券风险溢价起作用。如果一项QE操作预期在短期内被逆转，则其公告将对收益率和远期利率曲线产生驼峰状效应；否则，该效应可能随期限增加而增强。与QE公告相关的驼峰通常出现在比短期利率公告相关的驼峰更长的期限上，即使前者的效应预期持续时间较短。我们利用该模型重新审视美国QE公告的实证证据。

title: The role of the media in corporate governance: evidence from shareholder proposals 1
title_zh: 媒体在公司治理中的作用：来自股东提案的证据
title_primary: 媒体在公司治理中的作用：来自股东提案的证据
title_secondary: The role of the media in corporate governance: evidence from shareholder proposals 1
authors: Alberta Di Giuli, Arthur Romec
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the role played by the media in the shareholder proposal process. We find a positive relation between media coverage and the likelihood of being targeted by governance proposals. The effect is mostly observed for proposals submitted by non-institutional shareholders and driven by negative news. We further show that both “first reports” and repeated news contribute to increasing the probability of being targeted by governance proposals. This suggests that the media influence the shareholder proposal process both by conveying information to market participants and increasing firms' visibility. Negative media coverage is also associated with the success of proposals and changes in executive compensation and board turnover. Instrumental variable analysis and tests exploiting local newspaper closures suggest that the relationship between media coverage and shareholder proposals is causal. Our results shed light on a new channel through which the media can play a corporate governance role.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了媒体在股东提案过程中所扮演的角色。我们发现，媒体报道与成为治理提案目标的可能性之间存在正相关关系。这一效应主要体现在非机构股东提交的提案中，且由负面新闻驱动。我们进一步表明，“首次报道”和重复新闻均有助于提高成为治理提案目标的概率。这表明，媒体通过向市场参与者传递信息并提升企业可见度，从而影响股东提案过程。负面媒体报道还与提案的成功、高管薪酬变动及董事会更替相关联。工具变量分析及利用地方报纸停刊的检验表明，媒体报道与股东提案之间的关系具有因果性。我们的研究结果揭示了媒体发挥公司治理作用的新渠道。

title: The Economics of Paid Sick Leave
title_zh: 带薪病假的经济学
title_primary: 带薪病假的经济学
title_secondary: The Economics of Paid Sick Leave
authors: Pichler, Stefan, Prinz, Christopher, Thewissen, Stefan, Ziebarth, Nicolas
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article examines the economics of paid sick leave from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. Research on paid sick leave has evolved dynamically over the last decade, primarily driven by the spread of U.S. sick pay mandates, which have increased paid sick leave access from 63 percent to 77 percent in all U.S. jobs. We begin by discussing the economic rationales for government regulation of paid sick leave, particularly the negative externalities associated with contagious diseases when individuals work while sick. After that, we discuss the key trade-offs in the general design of paid sick leave schemes, along with the trade-offs when setting specific policy parameters. Finally, we review economic modeling approaches to study optimal paid sick leave policies.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论与实证两个维度探讨了带薪病假的经济学问题。过去十年间，带薪病假研究动态演进，主要受美国病假政策普及推动，该政策使全美工作中带薪病假的可及性从63%提升至77%。我们首先讨论政府对带薪病假进行监管的经济学理据，特别是当个体带病工作时，传染病所伴随的负外部性。随后，我们探讨带薪病假方案总体设计中的关键权衡，以及设定具体政策参数时的权衡。最后，我们回顾了研究最优带薪病假政策的经济学建模方法。

title: The Cov-lite Liquidity Advantage, Regulatory Pressures, and the Evolution of the Leveraged Loan Market
title_zh: 宽松流动性优势、监管压力与杠杆贷款市场的演变
title_primary: 宽松流动性优势、监管压力与杠杆贷款市场的演变
title_secondary: The Cov-lite Liquidity Advantage, Regulatory Pressures, and the Evolution of the Leveraged Loan Market
authors: Robert Prilmeier, René M. Stulz
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Following the global financial crisis (GFC), regulators made it harder for banks to retain leveraged loan exposure. We conjecture their actions increased the share of leveraged loan issuances with no maintenance covenants (cov-lite loans) because such loans are easier to sell. We find that, post-GFC, the share of cov-lite loan issuance increased more for banks facing stricter regulation, failing to pass a stress test outright, or exhibiting greater vulnerability to the severely adverse stress test scenario. We show that, as expected from theory, cov-lite loans have a liquidity advantage that lowers their credit spread and is higher for private firms.
abstract_zh: 全球金融危机后，监管机构加大了银行保留杠杆贷款敞口的难度。我们推测，这些举措提高了无维持条款（cov-lite）杠杆贷款发行的比例，因为此类贷款更易于出售。我们发现，危机后，面对更严格监管、未能直接通过压力测试或对严重不利压力测试情景表现出更大脆弱性的银行，其cov-lite贷款发行份额增长更为显著。我们证明，正如理论预期，cov-lite贷款具有流动性优势，这降低了其信用利差，且对私营企业而言这一优势更为明显。

title: Is Income Inequality on the Rise Everywhere?
title_zh: 收入不平等是否在全球范围内加剧？
title_primary: 收入不平等是否在全球范围内加剧？
title_secondary: Is Income Inequality on the Rise Everywhere?
authors: Facundo Alvaredo, Francois Bourguignon, Francisco Ferreira, Christoph Lakner, Nora Lustig
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper reviews the evidence on the levels and trends of income and consumption inequality around the world during 2000–2019. It examines how inequality levels vary across countries, whether inequality has been rising more often than declining, and how conclusions depend on the underlying income concept and data source. The analysis draws on two types of evidence: inequality estimates derived from household surveys and contained in harmonized databases such as WIID, PIP, and LIS, and estimates based on distributional national accounts from the World Inequality Database. The analysis pays particular attention to differences between income- and consumption-based measures, the under-coverage of top incomes in household surveys, and the assumptions underlying distributional national accounts. Two findings emerge. First, inequality levels differ substantially not only across countries, but also across concepts and data sources within countries. Measures based on national income generally show higher inequality than those based on household surveys, while consumption-based measures tend to yield lower inequality than income-based ones. Second, trends prove more robust than levels: across sources, inequality was more often declining or stable than increasing during the two decades preceding the pandemic. There is also some evidence of convergence, with declines more common among initially high-inequality countries and increases more frequent among initially low-inequality countries.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了2000年至2019年间全球收入与消费不平等水平及其变化趋势的证据。研究探讨了各国不平等程度的差异、不平等是否更常呈上升而非下降趋势，以及结论如何依赖于所采用的基本收入概念和数据来源。分析基于两类证据：一类源自住户调查并收录于WIID、PIP和LIS等统一数据库中的不平等估计；另一类则基于世界不平等数据库中的分配性国民账户估计。分析特别关注基于收入与基于消费的衡量指标之间的差异、住户调查对高收入群体覆盖不足的问题，以及分配性国民账户所依赖的假设。研究得出两项发现。第一，不平等水平不仅在各国间存在显著差异，在同一国家内，因概念和数据来源不同也差异明显。基于国民收入的衡量通常显示的不平等程度高于基于住户调查的结果，而基于消费的衡量往往比基于收入的衡量产生更低的不平等水平。第二，趋势比水平更具稳健性：从各数据来源看，在疫情前的二十年里，不平等下降或保持稳定的情况多于上升。同时，也存在一定的趋同证据，即初始不平等程度较高的国家更常出现下降，而初始不平等程度较低的国家则更常出现上升。

title: Alternative Contract Design: Analysing the Bankability of Fungible Derivative Contracts in Energy‐Only Markets
title_zh: 替代性合约设计：能量单一市场中可互换衍生品合约的可融资性分析
title_primary: 替代性合约设计：能量单一市场中可互换衍生品合约的可融资性分析
title_secondary: Alternative Contract Design: Analysing the Bankability of Fungible Derivative Contracts in Energy‐Only Markets
authors: Nicholas Gohdes, Tim Nelson, Phillip Hirschhorn
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: With the retirement of 21GW of legacy coal fleet looming, the task to replace Australia's thermal capacity with alternative firmed renewable ‘bulk energy’ solutions is non‐trivial. Indeed, calibrating necessary capital investment in new plant stock with efficient economic outcomes, vis‐à‐vis cost and reliability, represents a fundamental challenge to the ‘dynamic efficiency’ ideal for energy‐only markets. Recently, a major review of Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) has proposed that underwriting of new energy generation utilise fungible derivative contracts instead of the canonical run‐of‐plant (RoP) revenue contract design. The proposition is based upon re‐linking medium‐ and long‐term energy markets, while mitigating some of the worst externalities attributed to off‐market underwriting policies when implemented at‐scale. However, sound economic theory can collide with applied corporate finance in practice. The very basis of the RoP design has been to address the needs of capital markets vis‐à‐vis revenue quality for new‐entrant plant, making bankability a threshold issue for contract viability. This article examines a set of proposed fungible contract designs, leveraging 100 years of synthetic, stochastic market data to draw conclusions on the compatibility of contract fungibility and bankability. Findings indicate that eliminating incentive incompatibilities between plant dispatch and market signals (which are inherent in the RoP design) appears adequate to counteract ‘shape’ risk—both idiosyncratic and systematic—within the confines of a typical project finance structure. In other words, bankability and fungibility do not appear to be mutually exclusive.
abstract_zh: 随着21吉瓦传统燃煤发电机组退役的临近，用替代性固定可再生能源“大宗能源”解决方案来填补澳大利亚热力发电能力的任务绝非易事。实际上，将新电厂所需的资本投资与高效的经济成果（就成本和可靠性而言）进行校准，是对仅靠能源市场实现“动态效率”理想的一个根本性挑战。近期，对澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）的一项重大审查提议，新发电项目的承销应采用可互换衍生品合约，而非传统的按电厂运行（RoP）收入合约设计。该提议基于重新连接中长期能源市场，同时减轻大规模实施场外承销政策所带来的一些最严重外部性。然而，健全的经济理论在实践中可能与应用企业财务相冲突。RoP设计的基本出发点在于满足资本市场对新进入电厂收入质量的需求，使得可融资性成为合约可行性的关键问题。本文考察了一系列拟议的可互换合约设计，利用100年的合成随机市场数据，就合约可互换性与可融资性的兼容性得出结论。研究结果表明，消除电厂调度与市场信号之间的激励不兼容性（这是RoP设计固有的）似乎足以在典型项目融资结构范围内抵消“形状”风险——无论是特质性还是系统性风险。换言之，可融资性与可互换性并非相互排斥。

title: Is the EU ready for the next generation of investment? A cross-country sectoral growth accounting analysis of intangible capital in France and Germany
title_zh: 欧盟准备好迎接下一代投资了吗？法国与德国无形资产跨国部门增长核算分析
title_primary: 欧盟准备好迎接下一代投资了吗？法国与德国无形资产跨国部门增长核算分析
title_secondary: Is the EU ready for the next generation of investment? A cross-country sectoral growth accounting analysis of intangible capital in France and Germany
authors: Alberto Nonnis, Felix Roth, Ahmed Bounfour
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Motivated by recent calls for new investment to enhance EU competitiveness, this paper compares intangible capital accumulation in France and Germany, documenting large cross-country differences in investment levels, particularly in software and organizational capital. Yet, both countries have experienced similar labor productivity growth (LPG) from 1995 to 2021, raising questions about investment efficiency and potential measurement issues, especially in light of contrasting evidence from firm-level surveys. To shed further light on this puzzle, we conduct an econometric cross-country sectoral growth accounting analysis based on capital services growth rates. The results show that intangible capital contributed more to LPG in Germany than in France, despite the lower investment levels in the former. We interpret this finding primarily as reinforcing concerns about cross-country measurement inconsistencies and highlight the need for harmonizing intangible capital statistics to support more robust policy comparisons at the EU level.
abstract_zh: 受近期关于提升欧盟竞争力的新投资呼吁的启发，本文比较了法国和德国的无形资本积累情况，记录了在投资水平上的显著跨国差异，尤其是在软件和组织资本方面。然而，两国在1995年至2021年间经历了相似的全员劳动生产率增长，这引发了关于投资效率和潜在测量问题的疑问，尤其是考虑到企业层面调查中呈现的对比性证据。为深入探究这一谜团，我们基于资本服务增长率进行了跨国部门层面的增长核算计量分析。结果显示，尽管德国的投资水平较低，但其无形资本对全员劳动生产率增长的贡献大于法国。我们将这一发现主要解读为加剧了对跨国测量不一致性的担忧，并强调需要统一无形资本统计，以支持欧盟层面更为稳健的政策比较。

title: Exploring information provision to promote stem cell donation: Evidence from a field experiment of the Japan Marrow Donor Program
title_zh: 促进干细胞捐赠的信息提供探索：来自日本骨髓捐赠计划实地实验的证据
title_primary: 促进干细胞捐赠的信息提供探索：来自日本骨髓捐赠计划实地实验的证据
title_secondary: Exploring information provision to promote stem cell donation: Evidence from a field experiment of the Japan Marrow Donor Program
authors: Hiroki Kato, Fumio Ohtake, Saiko Kurosawa, Kazuhiro Yoshiuchi, Takahiro Fukuda
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Registered potential donors in stem cell transplantation may refuse to donate when matched with patients, causing supply shortages. To reduce such donor dropout, we developed behavioral interventions comprising messages added into the letters sent when donors are matched with patients in Japan, and conducted a field experiment to evaluate the effect of our intervention. The results demonstrate that the inclusion of our messages can reduce donor dropout and increase donor availability for transplantation. Specifically, the message emphasizing the limited number of compatible donors per patient increased the probability of donors completing the confirmatory typing stage by 7.3%. Since physicians can choose the best donor for proceeding to donation from those who complete confirmatory typing, this message increases donor availability for transplantation.
abstract_zh: 在干细胞移植中，已登记的潜在捐赠者在与患者匹配后可能拒绝捐赠，导致供应短缺。为减少此类捐赠者流失，我们开发了行为干预措施，即在日本捐赠者与患者匹配时发送的信件中加入信息，并开展了一项实地实验以评估干预效果。结果表明，加入我们的信息能减少捐赠者流失，提高移植可用的捐赠者数量。具体而言，强调每位患者匹配捐赠者数量有限的信息，使捐赠者完成确认分型阶段的可能性提高了7.3%。由于医生可以从完成确认分型的捐赠者中选择最佳捐赠者进行移植，这一信息增加了移植可用的捐赠者数量。

abstract: We explore the twin questions of when and how the strategy method creates behavioral distortions in the elicitation of choices in laboratory studies of sequential games. While such distortions have been widely documented, the theoretical forces driving these distortions remain poorly understood. In this paper, we compare behavior in six optimally designed centipede games, implemented under three different choice elicitation methods: the direct response method, the reduced strategy method and the full strategy method. These methods elicit behavioral strategies, reduced strategies, and complete strategies, respectively. We find significant behavioral differences across these elicitation methods—differences that cannot be explained by standard game theory, but are consistent with the predictions of the Dynamic Cognitive Hierarchy solution (Lin and Palfrey, 2024), combined with payoff dependent stochastic choice.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在序贯博弈实验室研究中，策略方法在何种条件下以及如何引发选择诱导中的行为偏差。尽管此类偏差已被广泛记录，但驱动这些偏差的理论力量仍未被充分理解。本文中，我们比较了六种最优设计的蜈蚣博弈中的行为，这些博弈在三种不同的选择诱导方法下实施：直接反应法、简化策略法和完整策略法。这些方法分别诱导行为策略、简化策略和完整策略。我们发现这些诱导方法之间存在显著的行为差异——这些差异无法用标准博弈论解释，但与动态认知层级解（Lin和Palfrey，2024）结合支付依赖的随机选择的预测一致。

title: Green spills: Peer effects in pro-environmental behaviors
title_zh: 绿色溢出：亲环境行为中的同伴效应
title_primary: 绿色溢出：亲环境行为中的同伴效应
title_secondary: Green spills: Peer effects in pro-environmental behaviors
authors: Patrick Bigler, Benedikt Janzen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines causal peer effects in pro-environmental behavior using geocoded panel data on 260,000 Swiss households from 2008 to 2019 and instrumental variables methods. We find that peer behavior has a simultaneous impact on a broad range of energy-related practices. In particular, we find that peer solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption increases household electricity conservation efforts, with each additional solar PV installation at 100 meters’ distance to a household reducing a household’s annual electricity consumption by 0.2%. We also document peer effects both within and across markets for pro-environmental durable goods, with increased uptake of solar PV and electric vehicles following new solar PV installations nearby. We find suggestive evidence that peer influence manifests itself in different ways contingent upon households’ constraints. Our findings have important implications for renewable energy subsidy evaluation. To illustrate this we calculate the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) of the existing solar PV subsidy scheme. In this setting, accounting for peer effects increases the estimated MVPF by approximately 17%. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 本文利用2008年至2019年间26万户瑞士家庭的地理编码面板数据及工具变量方法，考察了亲环境行为中的同伴因果效应。研究发现，同伴行为对一系列与能源相关的实践具有即时影响。具体而言，同伴太阳能光伏（PV）的采用增加了家庭节电努力，每增加一个距离家庭100米范围内的太阳能光伏安装，可使该家庭年用电量减少0.2%。我们还记录了亲环境耐用品市场内及跨市场的同伴效应，即附近新增太阳能光伏安装后，太阳能光伏和电动汽车的采用率随之上升。我们发现了提示性证据，表明同伴影响根据家庭约束条件的不同而以不同方式显现。我们的发现对可再生能源补贴评估具有重要意义。为说明这一点，我们计算了现有太阳能光伏补贴方案的公共资金边际价值（MVPF）。在此情境下，考虑同伴效应会使估算的MVPF增加约17%。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种动态的买卖双方互动关系。与买方估值不同，买方需要交易的频率才是其私人信息。这一差异至关重要。在有承诺的情况下，完全剩余提取是可能的，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情况下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不一定意味着买方处于强势地位。由于时间具有信息价值，卖方会随着时间推移学习并可能调整其行为。当寻找合适的替代卖方较为容易时，她会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当寻找合适的替代卖方需要时间时，她会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。

title: Temperature Fluctuations and Economic Conditions: Evidence from Weekly U.S. Data
title_zh: 温度波动与经济状况：来自美国周度数据的证据

official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how temperature fluctuations affect U.S. state-level economic conditions using high frequency, weekly data from 1987 to 2024. The impulse response to a temperature shock from a panel local projection framework reveals a modest short-run increase in economic conditions followed by a delayed and persistent medium-run decline. Nonlinearities show that the medium-run decline is larger and more persistent at higher base temperatures. A decomposition of the economic conditions index points to the labor market as the primary channel. To interpret these findings, we develop a weekly labor search and matching model featuring a labor disutility channel, a heat damage stock, and a slow-moving adaptation mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1987年至2024年的高频周度数据，研究温度波动如何影响美国各州经济状况。基于面板局部投影框架的温度冲击脉冲响应显示，经济状况在短期内温和上升，随后出现延迟且持续的中期下降。非线性分析表明，在较高基准温度下，中期下降幅度更大且更持久。对经济状况指数的分解表明，劳动力市场是主要传导渠道。为解释这些发现，我们构建了一个包含劳动负效用渠道、热损害存量以及缓慢调整适应机制的周度劳动力搜索与匹配模型。

title: Risk Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
title_zh: 风险分担检验与协变量冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪涝与虫害

authors: Ligon, Ethan
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Efficient risk-sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). We describe all preferences which permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures, and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial.
abstract_zh: 有效风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）存在一个简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以共同价格。标准方法通过总支出推断MUEs，隐含假设了同质性偏好、单位收入弹性以及相同的价格弹性。基于总支出的风险分担检验适用于异质性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“协变量”冲击（价格变化）。我们描述了所有允许从支出推断MUEs的偏好类型，并估计了非同质性MUEs，以检验乌干达的协变量冲击是否得到有效分担。这一方法得出了合理的结果；而标准方法则暗示干旱、洪水和虫害是有益的。

title: Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: A Reassessment
title_zh: 制造业的无条件收敛：一个再评估
title_primary: 制造业的无条件收敛：一个再评估
title_secondary: Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: A Reassessment
authors: Herrendorf, Berthold, Rogerson, Richard, Valentinyi, Ákos
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The movement of labor out of the agricultural sector is a central feature of the development process. A long-held belief is that successful development requires that much of the labor released from agriculture be allocated to manufacturing rather than services. Rodrik’s (2013) finding of unconditional convergence for manufacturing productivity using data from UNIDO provided empirical support for this view. We argue that the UNIDO data are ill–suited to study cross-country productivity dynamics. We use recently released data from the GGDC that was developed especially to study cross-country sectoral productivity dynamics to revisit this issue. We find no evidence of unconditional convergence in manufacturing productivity over the period 1990–2018.
abstract_zh: 劳动力从农业部门转移是发展进程的核心特征。长期以来，人们普遍认为成功的发展需要将农业释放的大部分劳动力配置到制造业而非服务业。Rodrik（2013）基于联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）数据发现的制造业生产率无条件趋同现象，为这一观点提供了实证支持。我们认为UNIDO数据并不适用于研究跨国生产率动态。本文采用GGDC最新发布的、专为研究跨国部门生产率动态而开发的数据集重新审视该问题。研究发现，1990-2018年期间不存在制造业生产率无条件趋同的证据。

title: The Segregative Effects of Charter Schools

abstract: I study the effects of charters on student racial segregation, identifying a novel mechanism: the assignment of White and non-White students to regular classrooms within their school-grade. Exploiting almost 100 entries of elementary charters in North Carolina from 1997 to 2015, I show that the announcement of an opening significantly increases classroom segregation within public schools nearby, relative to schools farther away, especially within non-majority-White schools and for charter openings that enroll a relatively large share of White students. Accounting for classrooms is unlikely to reverse the literature’s conclusion that the charter effects on student segregation are modest in magnitude. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了特许学校对学生种族隔离的影响，并识别出一种新机制：白人和非白人学生在其所在年级的常规班级中的分配。利用1997年至2015年间北卡罗来纳州近100所小学特许学校的设立数据，我表明，与距离较远的学校相比，特许学校开学的公告显著增加了附近公立学校内部的班级隔离，尤其是在非白人占多数的学校以及招收白人学生比例相对较高的特许学校中。考虑班级层面的因素不太可能推翻文献中关于特许学校对学生隔离影响程度较小的结论。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15）

abstract: Perceived shortcomings in the dominant asset market format, CDA, have provoked reform proposals including Flow, which features gradual trading. We report a laboratory experiment comparing formats in a simple single-asset private values environment. We find that Flow reduces price volatility, enhances liquidity, and encourages traders to send fewer and larger orders, indicating more effective shredding. In our simple environment, both formats deliver comparable trading volume, allocative efficiency and price efficiency.
abstract_zh: 对主流资产市场形式CDA的感知缺陷引发了包括Flow在内的改革提案，其特点是渐进式交易。我们报告了一项实验室实验，在简单的单一资产私人价值环境中比较了不同市场形式。研究发现，Flow降低了价格波动性，增强了流动性，并促使交易者发送更少但更大的订单，表明更有效的订单拆分。在我们的简单环境中，两种形式在交易量、配置效率和价格效率方面表现相当。

title: Resetting the Innovation Clock: Endogenous Growth through Technological Turnover
title_zh: 重置创新时钟：技术更替驱动的内生增长
title_primary: 重置创新时钟：技术更替驱动的内生增长
title_secondary: Resetting the Innovation Clock: Endogenous Growth through Technological Turnover
authors: Aghion, Philippe, Bergeaud, Antonin, Boppart, Timo, Brouillette, Jean-Félix
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We propose a model of endogenous economic growth with “weak” scale effects and diminishing returns to innovation at the micro level. In our model, entrants introduce new technologies through research and incumbents incrementally improve them through development. Over time, further improvement becomes harder such that firms ultimately run out of ideas and exit, paving the way for entrants that discover new technologies with further room for improvement. This turnover gives rise to a continuous stream of (temporary) opportunities for technological improvements that sustain economic growth. In a stationary equilibrium, the longrun growth rate is constant and endogenous to market incentives.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有“弱”规模效应和微观层面创新收益递减特征的内生经济增长模型。在该模型中，市场进入者通过研发引入新技术，而在位企业则通过开发活动对技术进行渐进式改进。随着时间推移，技术改进难度逐渐增大，企业最终因创新空间枯竭而退出市场，这为能够发现具有更大改进空间新技术的进入者创造了条件。这种企业更替机制产生了持续不断的（暂时性）技术改进机会，从而支撑经济长期增长。在稳态均衡中，长期增长率保持恒定，且内生于市场激励。

title: Shifting Work Patterns with Generative AI
title_zh: 生成式AI带来的工作模式转变

official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We present evidence from a field experiment across 66 firms and 7,137 knowledge workers. Workers were randomly selected to access a generative AI tool integrated into applications they already used at work for email, meetings, and writing. In the second half of the 6-month experiment, the 80% of treated workers who used the tool spent two fewer hours on email each week and reduced their time working outside of regular hours. Apart from these individual time savings, we do not detect shifts in the quantity or composition of workers’ tasks resulting from individual-level AI provision.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项涵盖66家企业和7,137名知识工作者的实地实验提供了证据。部分工作者被随机选中，获得一项生成式人工智能工具的访问权限，该工具已集成到他们工作中已使用的电子邮件、会议和写作应用程序中。在为期6个月的实验后半段，使用该工具的80%受试工作者每周在电子邮件上花费的时间减少了两个小时，并且减少了在常规工作时间之外的工作时长。除了这些个人时间节省外，我们未发现因个体层面提供人工智能而导致工作者任务数量或构成发生变化。

title: Estimating exact efficiency in multi-weight spatial autoregressive stochastic frontier models

abstract: Spatial autoregressive stochastic frontier models allow inefficiency to propagate across connected units. However, invertibility of the system matrix alone does not guarantee that exact spillover-corrected efficiency is admissible. If the inverse of the system matrix has negative entries, some non-negative inefficiency realizations imply negative total inefficiency and efficiency scores above one. Under non-negative spatial autoregressive parameters, we characterize the admissible parameter space for general non-negative spatial weighting matrices and extend the analysis to models with multiple weighting matrices. We also provide a practical sufficient condition and, for row-normalized multi-weight models, a simple necessary and sufficient restriction.
abstract_zh: 空间自回归随机前沿模型允许无效率在相连单元间传播。然而，系统矩阵的可逆性本身并不保证经溢出校正的精确效率具有可采纳性。若系统矩阵的逆矩阵含有负元素，则某些非负的无效率实现会导致总无效率为负，效率得分超过1。在非负空间自回归参数下，我们刻画了一般非负空间权重矩阵的可采纳参数空间，并将分析扩展到具有多个权重矩阵的模型。我们还提供了一个实用的充分条件，并针对行归一化的多权重模型，给出了一个简洁的必要且充分约束。

title: A goodness-of-fit test for sparse networks
title_zh: 稀疏网络拟合优度检验
title_primary: 稀疏网络拟合优度检验
title_secondary: A goodness-of-fit test for sparse networks
authors: Yujia Wu, Wei Lan, Long Feng, Chih-Ling Tsai
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The stochastic block model (SBM) has been widely used to analyze network data. Various goodness-of-fit tests have been proposed to assess the adequacy of model structures. To the best of our knowledge, however, none of the existing approaches are applicable for sparse networks in which the connection probability of any two communities is of order log(n)/n, and the number of communities is divergent. To fill this gap, we propose a novel goodness-of-fit test for the stochastic block model. The key idea is to construct statistics by sampling the maximum entry-deviations of the adjacency matrix that the negative impacts of network sparsity are alleviated by the sampling process. We demonstrate theoretically that the proposed test statistic converges to the Type-I extreme value distribution under the null hypothesis regardless of the network structure. Accordingly, it can be applied to both dense and sparse networks. In addition, we obtain the asymptotic power against alternatives. Moreover, we introduce a bootstrap-corrected test statistic to improve the finite sample performance, recommend an augmented test statistic to increase the power, and extend the proposed test to the degree-corrected SBM. Simulation studies and two empirical examples with both dense and sparse networks indicate that the proposed method performs well.
abstract_zh: 随机块模型（SBM）已被广泛用于分析网络数据。为评估模型结构的充分性，已有多种拟合优度检验方法被提出。然而，据我们所知，现有方法均不适用于连接概率为log(n)/n量级且社区数量发散的稀疏网络。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种针对随机块模型的新型拟合优度检验方法。其核心思想是通过采样邻接矩阵的最大条目偏差来构造统计量，从而通过采样过程减轻网络稀疏性的负面影响。我们从理论上证明，在原假设下，所提出的检验统计量收敛于第一类极值分布，且与网络结构无关。因此，该方法可同时适用于稠密和稀疏网络。此外，我们获得了备择假设下的渐近功效。进一步地，我们引入了一种基于自助法的修正统计量以提升有限样本性能，推荐了一种增强统计量以增加检验功效，并将所提检验扩展至度修正的SBM。模拟研究及两个涵盖稠密与稀疏网络的实证案例表明，所提方法表现良好。

title: Dynamic Individuals, Static Neighborhoods: Migration and Earnings Changes in Poor Neighborhoods

official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies migration and earnings dynamics in poor neighborhoods using new administrative data linking residential location and earnings. Out-migration rates are higher in poor neighborhoods than elsewhere, and the majority of people who leave a poor neighborhood move to a richer one. Residents of poor neighborhoods also see significant earnings mobility, with average growth rates similar to richer areas. Estimates based on idiosyncratic, firm-specific pay changes show that increases in earnings are linked to migration to better neighborhoods. This results in the earnings of the cohort who lived in a poor neighborhood at baseline growing more than twice as fast as the earnings of these neighborhoods' contemporaneous residents. Overall, our results highlight an underappreciated reason why poor neighborhoods stay poor: initial residents whose earnings grow tend to move away.
abstract_zh: 本文利用连接居住地与收入的新行政数据，研究贫困社区的迁移与收入动态。贫困社区的迁出率高于其他地区，且大多数离开贫困社区的人会迁往更富裕的社区。贫困社区居民的收入流动性也显著，其平均增长率与富裕地区相当。基于个体层面及企业特定薪酬变化的估计表明，收入增长与迁往更优社区存在关联。这导致基线期居住在贫困社区的群体收入增长速度，是同期仍居住在这些社区的居民收入增速的两倍以上。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了一个未被充分认识的贫困社区持续贫困的原因：收入增长的初始居民往往会迁离。

abstract: This paper examines the impact of additional income provided to low-income families immediately after childbirth on criminal justice involvement. Using a regression discontinuity design, I exploit a policy that allows children born before year-end to be claimed as dependents for that tax year, thereby providing additional cash during the first year of parenthood. Using linked administrative data, I find that this extra income immediately reduces the likelihood of criminal charges and incarceration among first-time fathers, particularly for income-related offenses. In the long run, it also reduces juvenile justice involvement among their children.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了低收入家庭在生育后立即获得额外收入对刑事司法介入的影响。利用断点回归设计，我利用一项允许年终前出生的儿童在该纳税年度被申报为被抚养人的政策，从而在育儿第一年提供额外现金。通过关联行政数据，我发现这笔额外收入立即降低了初为人父者面临刑事指控和监禁的可能性，尤其是与收入相关的犯罪。从长期来看，这也减少了其子女的青少年司法介入。

title: Economic Sanctions and Taxation of Natural Resource Rent: Evidence From Spatial Analysis

abstract: This paper examines the effects of economic sanctions on the taxation of natural resources in targeted countries, distinguishing between de jure and de facto measures of the average effective tax rate (AETR) on resource rents. The analysis relies on a sample of 20 African countries for the de jure AETR and a global panel of 75 developing and developed countries for the de facto AETR over the period 2000–2020. Using a Spatial Durbin Model that accounts for spatial spillovers in both taxation and sanctions, we document three main results. First, both resource taxation (de jure and de facto) and economic sanctions exhibit significant spatial dependence across neighbouring countries. Second, economic sanctions affect de jure rent capture, while their impact on de facto AETR is limited and operates mainly through indirect and spillover channels rather than through a direct strengthening of effective tax enforcement. Third, the effects vary by the type and origin of sanctions, with financial sanctions exerting stronger effects than trade sanctions, and UN and US sanctions proving more influential than EU sanctions. The results are robust to alternative measures of sanction intensity, proxied by the number of sanctions imposed, as well as to alternative estimation strategies addressing endogeneity, and dynamic treatment effects. These findings suggest that sanctioned countries adjust formal tax policy in response to sanctions, which contribute to limit the adverse effect of sanctions on their de facto taxation of the resource rent.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济制裁对目标国自然资源税收的影响，区分了资源租金平均有效税率（AETR）的法律规定与实际执行指标。分析基于2000-2020年期间两个样本：20个非洲国家的法律规定AETR，以及75个发达国家与发展中国家组成的全球面板数据的实际执行AETR。采用考虑税收与制裁空间溢出效应的空间杜宾模型，我们得出三项主要结论。第一，资源税收（包括法律规定与实际执行）和经济制裁在邻国间均呈现显著的空间依赖性。第二，经济制裁影响法律规定的租金获取，但对实际执行AETR的影响有限，且主要通过间接和溢出渠道发挥作用，而非直接强化有效税收执法。第三，制裁效果因类型和来源而异：金融制裁的影响强于贸易制裁，联合国和美国制裁的影响力超过欧盟制裁。上述结果在采用制裁数量作为制裁强度替代指标、处理内生性的替代估计策略以及动态处理效应检验中均保持稳健。这些发现表明，受制裁国会根据制裁调整正式税收政策，这有助于限制制裁对其资源租金实际征税的不利影响。

title: The spatial allocation effects of central transfers: evidence from China

abstract: Coordinating the fiscal relations between the central and local governments is a worldwide governance challenge. Based on a spatial general equilibrium framework, we quantify the aggregate effects of tax-sharing adjustments (i.e. fiscal revenue division) and the spatial allocation of central transfers (i.e. fiscal expenditure assignment) through labor migration. Calibrating the model for China, we find that adjusting the tax-sharing ratio induces co-directional changes in regional disparity, aggregate output, and welfare. Changes in the spatial allocation structure of central transfers during 2016–2021 mitigated labor misallocation, reducing regional disparities by 1.09% and increasing aggregate output by 4.44%, but causing welfare to decline by 3.03%. A reduction in labor migration costs amplifies the spatial allocation effects of central transfers. Moreover, the spatial allocation effects of different types of central transfers show significant differences.
abstract_zh: 协调中央与地方政府之间的财政关系是一项全球性的治理挑战。基于空间一般均衡框架，我们量化了税收分成调整（即财政收入划分）与中央转移支付的空间配置（即财政支出分配）通过劳动力迁移产生的总体效应。以中国为模型校准对象，我们发现调整税收分成比例会引发区域差距、总产出和福利的同向变化。2016至2021年间中央转移支付空间配置结构的变动缓解了劳动力错配，使区域差距缩小1.09%，总产出增加4.44%，但导致福利下降3.03%。劳动力迁移成本的降低会放大中央转移支付的空间配置效应。此外，不同类型中央转移支付的空间配置效应存在显著差异。

abstract: This paper extends the vector autoregression framework by introducing a flexible distributional regression that models multivariate time series without imposing restrictive parametric distribution assumptions. We develop a distributional impulse response function that captures the future effect of distributional disturbances within the system, providing a more detailed view of dynamic heterogeneity. We propose a straightforward estimation method and establish its asymptotic properties under weak dependence assumptions. Our model, in an application to U.S. economic data, exhibits strong forecasting capabilities compared to existing alternatives. By examining distributional interactions and monetary policy impacts, particularly during the Great Recession, we uncover complex macroeconomic dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文通过引入一种灵活的分布回归方法，扩展了向量自回归框架，该方法在不施加严格参数分布假设的情况下对多元时间序列进行建模。我们开发了一种分布脉冲响应函数，用以捕捉系统内分布扰动的未来效应，从而更细致地揭示动态异质性。我们提出了一种简便的估计方法，并在弱依赖假设下确立了其渐近性质。在应用于美国经济数据时，我们的模型展现出相较于现有替代方法的强大预测能力。通过考察分布交互作用及货币政策影响，尤其是在大衰退期间，我们揭示了复杂的宏观经济动态。

abstract: This mixed‐method study undertakes a comprehensive inquiry of the public discourse on social media surrounding quantitative easing (QE) across the US, the UK, and the European Union. Utilizing a unique tweet dataset, we reveal the sentiment polarity toward QE policy to be strongly negative, at 71.27%, with positive sentiment a mere 4.25%. Distilling the negative QE sentiment, we identify prominent themes of “anti‐government,” “anti‐central bank,” “inequality,” “ineffectiveness,” “inflation,” and “asset inflation,” and demonstrate a longitudinal association between perceived inequality and asset price inflation with an anti‐establishment stance. We conclude with suggested central bank policy recommendations to restore and foster public trust.
abstract_zh: 本混合方法研究对美国、英国及欧盟社交媒体上围绕量化宽松（QE）的公共话语进行了全面探究。利用独特的推文数据集，我们发现公众对QE政策的情绪倾向强烈负面，占比71.27%，而正面情绪仅为4.25%。通过提炼负面QE情绪，我们识别出“反政府”、“反央行”、“不平等”、“无效性”、“通胀”及“资产通胀”等突出主题，并展示了感知不平等与资产价格通胀在纵向维度上与反建制立场之间的关联。最后，我们提出央行政策建议，以恢复并增进公众信任。

abstract: We evaluate equity-efficiency trade-offs from admissions quotas by examining effects on output once beneficiaries start producing in the relevant industry. We estimate the impact of abolishing a 40 percent quota for male primary school teachers on their pupils’ long-run outcomes. We combine this reform with the timing of union-bargained teacher retirements to isolate quasi-random variation in male quota teachers. Pupils exposed to male quota teachers transition more smoothly to postcompulsory education and have higher educational attainment and labor force attachment at age 25. Evidence suggests the quota improved the allocation of talent by mending imperfections in the unconstrained selection process. (JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45)

title: Environmental governance effect on the economic growth-A novel empirical test
title_zh: 环境治理对经济增长的影响——一项新的实证检验

abstract: This study verifies the role of environmental governance in promoting high-quality economic development (HQED) and establishes a systematic evaluation framework for assessing both urban environmental governance and economic performance. The empirical results demonstrate that stricter environmental regulation significantly enhances the quality of urban economic growth, lending support to Porter’s hypothesis. Effective environmental supervision stimulates the adoption of green production technologies, boosts total factor productivity, and strengthens cities’ capacity to attract skilled human capital, thereby fostering a more sustainable and innovation-driven growth model. Heterogeneity analysis further indicates that this positive effect is broadly consistent across different regions, confirming the feasibility and effectiveness of government-led environmental regulation as a tool for advancing high-quality development. Nonetheless, the marginal impact of such regulation weakens in the later phases of governance, suggesting that once a certain threshold of regulatory intensity is reached, additional tightening yields diminishing returns to economic upgrading.
abstract_zh: 本研究验证了环境治理在促进经济高质量发展（HQED）中的作用，并构建了一个系统评估框架，用以衡量城市环境治理与经济绩效。实证结果表明，更严格的环境规制显著提升了城市经济增长的质量，支持了波特假说。有效的环境监管激励了绿色生产技术的采纳，提高了全要素生产率，并增强了城市吸引技能型人力资本的能力，从而促进了更具可持续性和创新驱动型的增长模式。异质性分析进一步表明，这一积极效应在不同地区间大体一致，证实了政府主导的环境规制作为推进高质量发展工具的可行性与有效性。然而，此类规制的边际影响在治理后期有所减弱，表明一旦规制强度达到某一阈值，进一步收紧对经济升级的回报将递减。

abstract: We propose a new model of internal migration, based on persistent and spatially correlated idiosyncratic utility. The model is motivated by a new fact in the data that simple moving cost models struggle to match: the t-year interstate migration rate is proportional to the square root of t. The new model maintains the tractability and flexibility of standard migration models, but better matches the dynamics of migration, including the new fact. It has substantially different welfare implications and makes different counterfactual predictions, especially in terms of dynamic adjustment and long-run responses.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于持久且空间相关的异质性效用的内部迁移新模型。该模型的提出源于数据中一个简单迁移成本模型难以匹配的新事实：t年跨州迁移率与t的平方根成正比。新模型保留了标准迁移模型的易处理性和灵活性，但能更好地匹配迁移的动态特征，包括这一新事实。该模型在福利含义上具有显著差异，并得出不同的反事实预测，尤其是在动态调整和长期响应方面。

abstract: We study the binary choice problem in a data‐rich environment with asymmetric loss functions. The econometrics literature covers nonparametric binary choice problems but does not offer computationally attractive solutions in data‐rich environments. The machine learning literature has many algorithms but is focused mostly on loss functions that are independent of covariates. We show that theoretically valid decisions on binary outcomes with general loss functions can be achieved via a very simple loss‐based reweighting of logistic regression or state‐of‐the‐art machine learning techniques. We apply our analysis to algorithmic fairness in pretrial detentions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了数据丰富环境下具有非对称损失函数的二元选择问题。计量经济学文献涵盖了非参数二元选择问题，但未提供在数据丰富环境中具有计算吸引力的解决方案。机器学习文献虽包含众多算法，但主要关注与协变量无关的损失函数。我们证明，通过基于损失函数对逻辑回归或前沿机器学习技术进行极其简单的重新加权，即可在一般损失函数下实现理论上有效的二元结果决策。我们将分析应用于审前羁押中的算法公平性问题。

abstract: Improving access to formal finance is crucial for the growth of women-owned enterprises in emerging economies. This paper investigates whether the use of technology enhances access to formal credit for women entrepreneurs in India’s unorganized sector. Based on enterprise-level data from the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE) 2022–2023 round, we present the following key findings: (1) Women-owned enterprises are significantly less likely to obtain formal credit and, when they obtain loans, they secure smaller loan amounts, confirming a gender gap in accessing formal credit. (2) Technology usage, captured by computer and internet usage, improves both the likelihood of receiving formal loans and the size of loans for women-owned firms, reflecting the positive effect of technology adoption in bridging the gender gap. (3) Women-owned enterprises adopting technology witness improved access to formal credit through the use of the internet for banking and accessing other financial services. (4) The positive formal credit access-enhancing effect of technology usage is driven by rural firms in terms of loan access and by both rural and urban firms in terms of loan amounts. These results have significant implications for promoting gender equity in accessing formal finance through targeted digital interventions for women entrepreneurs. abstract_zh: 改善正规融资渠道对于新兴经济体中女性创办企业的成长至关重要。本文探究了技术应用是否有助于印度非正规部门女性创业者获得正规信贷。基于2022-2023年度《非正规部门企业年度调查》（ASUSE）的企业层面数据，我们得出以下主要发现：（1）女性创办企业获得正规信贷的可能性显著更低，且即使获得贷款，其贷款金额也较小，这证实了正规信贷获取中存在性别差距。（2）以计算机和互联网使用衡量的技术应用，既提高了女性创办企业获得正规贷款的可能性，也增加了贷款规模，反映出技术采纳在弥合性别差距方面的积极作用。（3）采用技术的女性创办企业通过使用互联网进行银行业务及获取其他金融服务，改善了正规信贷的可及性。（4）技术应用对正规信贷获取的积极促进作用，在贷款可得性方面由农村企业驱动，而在贷款金额方面则由城乡企业共同驱动。这些结论对于通过针对女性创业者的定向数字干预措施促进正规融资领域的性别平等具有重要政策启示。关键词：金融包容性 性别差距 技术采纳 女性创业者 JEL分类号：G21 J16 L26 O33
